text: The carriage rolled on as if nothing had happened, and to keep the heat from giving away the truth, carts of salted fish were placed beside it.
spoken: The carriage rolled on, as if nothing had happened. And to keep the heat from giving away the truth... [sigh] carts of salted fish were placed beside it.
